titulo: Aunque + present indicative vs present subjunctive
subtitulo: Aunque llueve, salgo / Aunque llueva, salgo.
regla: Aunque + indicative: a fact you're stating, maybe new for the listener (although it IS raining). Aunque + subjunctive: something already known to both (even though), or something that may or may not happen (even if).

bloques.texto: **Aunque** (_although, even though, even if_) takes either mood, and the meaning changes.

filas: a fact the speaker states, often new info for the listener
Voy a salir aunque llueve. (_It is raining, FYI._)
a fact both people already know; it doesn't matter
Voy a salir aunque llueva. (_Yes, it's raining, so what._)
a possibility that may or may not happen
Voy a salir al rato aunque llueva. (_Even if it rains._)

bloques.texto: Sometimes the subjunctive is ambiguous between _known_ and _possible_: **Aunque esté nevando, voy a sacar al perro** could be either.
Same rule for **a pesar de que**, **por más que**, **por mucho que**, **si bien** (**si bien** usually takes the indicative).
Tip: indicative = I'm telling you. Subjunctive = it doesn't matter.

lista.es: ==Aunque== Guadalajara ==es== una ciudad impresionante, prefiero Monterrey.
lista.en: Although Guadalajara is an impressive city, I prefer Monterrey. (I'm telling you.)

lista.es: ==Aunque== Guadalajara ==sea== una ciudad impresionante, prefiero Monterrey.
lista.en: Even though Guadalajara is impressive (we both know), I prefer Monterrey.

lista.es: ==Aunque== me ==duele== la cabeza, voy a seguir trabajando.
lista.en: Although I have a headache, I'm going to keep working.

lista.es: ==Aunque== me ==supliques==, no me voy a casar contigo.
lista.en: Even if you beg me, I'm not going to marry you.

lista.es: No vas a ir a ese viaje ==aunque consigas== el dinero.
lista.en: You're not going on that trip even if you get the money.

lista.es: ==Por más que== me lo ==explicas==, no lo entiendo.
lista.en: No matter how much you explain it, I don't get it.

lista.es: ==Por mucho que== me lo ==expliques==, no lo voy a entender.
lista.en: No matter how much you explain it, I'm not going to get it.

filas.t: Mañana voy aunque llueve. (it might rain)
Aunque es caro, lo voy a comprar.
Aunque sea caro, lo voy a comprar.

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: Complete (it might happen): _Voy a ir aunque ___ (hacer) frío._
Complete (telling a fact): _Aunque ___ (ser, él) mi hermano, no confío en él._
In Spanish: _Even if you don't believe me, it's true._
lista.r: Aunque no me creas, es verdad.
